extraction_notes: Only main-text Figure 1 contains measured catalytic performance plots. Figures 5–7 are in situ spectroscopy/DFT/mechanistic plots and were not treated as catalytic performance data. Supporting-information performance figures mentioned in the text were not digitised because the request was for main-text figures. All plotted values are approximate visual reads from the supplied page images; table/text printed values may be more precise in the separate extraction pass.
